I'll get you what you want. I'll get you more. Oh, it’s easy, to be sure; but what’s easy is always difficult. It’s there, down there, lying there. The trick is how to get it— and who knows that? Think about it. In those days when hordes of migrating humanity flooded the land, those times of terror, this man, that man, many men, in fear hid away in the earth, here and there, their most precious possessions. It’s been that way always, from the times of the mighty Romans to yesterday— even to today. And it’ all still there, buried in the earth, lying in silence. And since the earth is the Emperor’s, it’s the Emperor who should have it.

我会给你你想要的。我会给你更多。哦，这当然很容易；但容易的事总是困难的。它就在那儿，在那儿，躺在那儿。关键在于如何获得它——谁知道呢？想一想。在那些大群的人类迁徙淹没这片土地的日子里，那些恐怖的时代，这个人、那个人、许多人，在恐惧中把他们最宝贵的财产藏在地下，到处都是。从强大的罗马时代到昨天，甚至到今天，情况一直如此。而这一切仍然在那里，埋在地下，静静地躺着。既然地球是皇帝的，那它就应该是皇帝的。
